value.text:
The complete schema for a fresh SQLite install is provided by `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`.

`store/migrator.go` documents this file as the full schema for new installations. `preMigrate()` reads it when the database is uninitialized. It contains complete CREATE TABLE statements. `store/test/migrator_test.go` includes `TestFreshInstall` verifying its application on a fresh database.

  UNIQUE (provider, extern_uid),
  UNIQUE (user_id, provider)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_user_identity_user_id ON user_identity(user_id);
